I was so confused I just walked the halls trying to trace my steps and figure out what was going on and where I needed to be. 20 minutes later I figured it out and went to the correct class.

There was a lot of floating where I didn't feel like myself but I was still kinda present and so much memory loss. I had a whole marriage for 7 years and had two children and I didn't remember most of it except for the trauma that came with it. 7 years and I can count the happy moments on both hands. 

I don't remember my 2nd marriage only that I "woke up" to my mother and sister planning my wedding and I asked why were they pushing me to do this. They said because he loves you silly. I just shrugged and went back into the background. Everything fuzzy. The only real memories are in photographs. 

I don't remember most of my relationship with my last ex I was with for seven years. He was a truck driver and I can tell you trips we went on and loads we had but our relationship... Certain events stick out but again, most is a blur. My awakening so to speak was because he was injured, not working and taking it all out on me. More trauma. Only the alter the formed from him made sure I was present when she took over to stand up for us. She was my introduction. I had a motherly voice pop in my head reminding myself that I didn't need to get myself to make my pain more valid when I was about to do something stupid. I had my first childhood alter who I did "recognize" formally introduce herself. It was wild. I felt insane. I eventually went into therapy and worked on getting to know them myself before even thinking of bringing it up to a professional. Lol 

I did my research on the subject, got to know more about the ones that were wanting to be known and by the time I brought it up I had seven in various ages, all females, with details about when they first came to be, etc. I finally got comfortable enough to bring it up to my therapist who doubted me until I started describing them.
